Bill.BriefDescription: Providing Indian tribes with a right of first refusal to acquire certain park lands.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to transfer or disposal of certain park lands; andadding a new section to chapter 79A.05 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 79A.05 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The commission shall adopt by rule criteria for the transfer, sale,or other disposal of land under RCW 79A.05.170 and 79A.05.175. Thecommission shall provide Indian tribes the right of first refusal toacquire lands that have archaeological, historical, and culturalsignificance to federally recognized Indian tribes whose traditionallands and territories included parts of Washington.
